bullets: 【Universal RF & IR Control】 BroadLink Wi-Fi（2.4GHz Only, 5GHz or mesh networks not supported ）Smart Hub RM4 Pro works with 433MHz RF fixed-code devices (rolling code not supported), including motorized curtains, blinds, projectors, and light switches.
